title: the frozen session lifecycle contract of the api freeze
description: freezes the session lifecycle messages and the session record shape of protocolv2: the startsession, pausesession and resumesession runtime messages travel the background surface while the session record rides every versioned envelope the proposal request carries; the lifecycle stays consent first because a paused or expired session refuses every action and preview.

lifecycle.description: the frozen session lifecycle message names of the background surface

origin.description: the exact origin the session runs inside

startedat.description: the epoch milliseconds the session started

expiresat.description: the epoch milliseconds the session expires; an expired session refuses every action

stoppedat.description: the epoch milliseconds the user stopped the session

pausedat.description: the epoch milliseconds the user paused the session; a paused session refuses every action and preview

grants.description: the additional exact origins granted to the session

environmentgrants.description: the execution environments granted beside the origin grants

lockid.description: the sessionlock the running run acquired

agentid.description: the fleet agent bound to the session

jarid.description: the cookie jar the session cookie state stays scoped to
